transfer.radial_rule: At r=j/8, v=r/0.5; 2*(acos(v)-v*sqrt(1-v*v))/pi for 0<=v<1, else zero. Circle-pupil overlap area, normalized at zero. Round radial cells once to float32; these tabulated values with literal linear interpolation are the matched optical model, not the unsampled analytic curve.
transfer.axial_rule: H_z(k/4)=sum_j psf[j]*exp(-2*pi*i*k*j/4); exact repeating cells [1,0.25+0.125i,0,0.25-0.125i]. All three orders have the SAME separable transfer. Axial samples complex64 exact. Rounding to complex64 defines full table boundary.
transfer.matched_finite_model_limit: Periodic tabulated separable transfer in the accepted C acquisition coordinates. No experimental calibration authenticity or historical executable claim. All source kz=0: complex axial response is declared and consumed, but nonzero axial source recovery is not claimed.

source.analytic_rule: s(r)=dc+2*Re(sum c_k*exp(2*pi*i*(kx*x/8+ky*y/8+kz*z/4))); x,y,z are centered physical um. s is SIGNED density contrast, not nonnegative emitter density.
source.physical_pair: Reference density 16; specimen density 16+s. Both are nonnegative by the coefficient absolute-sum bound. Same nonnegative illumination and transfer for both. The signed source and result remain visible; the pedestal is only an acquisition explanation, never added to truth/result plots.
source.mass_rule: Source is continuous density; truth samples use output pitch(0.5,0.5,1)um, not an undersampled native source raster. A sampled quadrature mass weight is density*cell_volume_um3: detector-cell volume1, output-cell volume0.25. This weight is NOT the exact continuum mass in a finite cell. The exact centered cell integral is V*[dc+2*Re(sum c_k*exp(2*pi*i*f_k dot r)*product_axis sinc(f_axis*cell_pitch_axis)))], sinc(v)=sin(pi*v)/(pi*v). Its zero-frequency whole-field mass is dc*256=32 density-unit, exactly equal to either periodic grid quadrature sum. Counts are separately calibrated detector integrals, not source mass.
source.illumination_rule: ell_p(r)=1+2*Re(sum_m a_m*exp(-2*pi*i*m*k0 dot r-i*m*phi_p)); phi_p=2*pi*p/5. One direction, orders0/1/2, a0=1. Lower bound1-2*sum|a_m|>0. No drift or off-exposure combination.
source.detector_rule: Each member of the physical pair gets exposure1s, identical ell_p and optics. Ideal detector corrected counts=0.8*H[(density)*ell_p]; camera slope2 divides decoded counts. A calibrated analog difference is digitized ONCE as float32(7+3+(specimen_corrected-reference_corrected)/2). No independently quantized pair subtraction is claimed. Workflow gets this explicit differential count array, with no truth input and no off_exposures.
source.dose_rule: 5 paired phases per section, 4 sections:40 physical plane exposures of1s. Integrated phase illumination=sum_p ell_p=5 at each location, paired dose10s per section, stack40s. Conventional uses the identical quantized differential exposure set, hence identical total pair dose. No additional widefield acquisition, no shot/read noise or stochastic performance claim.
source.output_coordinate_unit_map: Source bin k corresponds exactly to (kx/8,ky/8,kz/4)cycles/um and output bin(kx,ky,kz) on16x16x4. Inverse centered labels x=(j-8)/2,y=(i-8)/2,z=h-2; index j=2*(x+4),i=2*(y+4),h=z+2. C image scale relative to density is P*gain/(L^2*A)=1.0 count/(density-unit/um^3), fixed BEFORE calls. Convert image to signed density by dividing by this1.0; no fit or registration. Coefficients/amplitudes and cell mass remain distinct.

conventional.rule: Correct same quantized raw by2*(raw-10); average all5 phases; divide by fixed gain0.8. Embed its unnormalized native finite DFT with positive even Nyquist lift in the16x16x4 output and divide by native256. No optical deconvolution, no extra dose, no per-result fit.
conventional.expected_high_modes: zero before quantization; finite quantization leakage is bounded independently

numerical_model.boundary: frozen raw float32 samples are exact mathematical input; transfer table complex64 cells promoted exactly. Binary64 observer and product arithmetic; compensated direct exponential sums for oracle, no product forward helper.
numerical_model.quantization_bound: Before observations, A=abs(dc)+2*sum|c|, J=1+2*sum|a|, raw_abs<=10+0.4*A*J. Per-sample nearest-float32 error <=2^-24*(10+0.4*A*J). Conventional density error<=2*error/0.8. Propagate this bound separately through fixed overlap/filter to quantify source bias; product equivalence starts at quantized raw, never at unquantized source.
numerical_model.transform_envelope: u=2^-53; gamma(n)=n*u/(1-n*u). eta=gamma(64*N*ceil(log2(2*N))+32*N), N=256, is an explicit conservative conditional binary64 stable FFT/libm envelope (includes complex arithmetic and twiddles), distinct from compensated direct-sum roundoff. No historical float32 error guarantee. Both computations are covered by this envelope. Fail rather than widen on violation.
numerical_model.propagation: Per-stage code ce08_recovery_budget.py derives bands, overlap norms, SX/SY/cross, forward-ratio and regularized native coefficient/assembly error. Fixed carrier has zero uncertainty; no finite search replay needed. Error-free transfer cells, scalar noise1, T1; w^2 positive. Denominator perturbations use literal finite signed enumeration. All comparisons absolute with rtol0. Equivalence tolerance must be<0.001 density and mode units, at least35x below physical mode criterion; otherwise preregistration fails without a product call.
